# Deskera

> Deskera is an all-in-one cloud-based ERP and manufacturing software platform that automates business processes across accounting, inventory, CRM, payroll, HRMS, and production planning.

Deskera provides integrated solutions for manufacturing and business operations, with specialized modules for ERP, MRP, inventory management, and supply chain optimization. The platform serves diverse manufacturing industries including automotive, aerospace, electronics, food, apparel, and construction.

## Key Topics

- ERP Software
- MRP (Manufacturing Resource Planning)
- Inventory Management
- Production Planning
- Supply Chain Management
- Bill of Materials (BoM)
- Manufacturing Software
- Quality Control
- Warehouse Management
- Work Order Management
- Demand Forecasting
- Procurement
- Industry 4.0
- CRM
- Cloud-Based ERP

## Core Products

- [Deskera ERP - Automate Business Processes | Boost Efficiency](https://www.deskera.com/erp): Cloud-based business automation and process efficiency solution for enterprise resource planning.
- [Deskera MRP - Streamline Manufacturing Operations | Boost Efficiency](https://www.deskera.com/mrp): Manufacturing resource planning software for production planning, inventory management, and operations.
- [All In One Business Software with Accounting, Inventory, CRM, Payroll and HRMS](https://www.deskera.com): Deskera's integrated platform combining ERP, MRP, accounting, inventory, CRM, payroll and HRMS modules.

## Manufacturing Industry Solutions

- [Transform Your Operations, from Chaos to Control](https://www.deskera.com/industries/industrial-manufacturing): Industrial manufacturing solution featuring Industry 4.0, IoT and AI integration for operational excellence.
- [Powering Innovation for Electronics Manufacturing](https://www.deskera.com/industries/high-tech-and-electronics): Electronics manufacturing ERP with production planning and supply chain management capabilities.
- [Your Roadmap to Enhanced Efficiency and Profitability in the Automotive Industry](https://www.deskera.com/industries/automotive-manufacturing): Automotive manufacturing ERP and MRP with quality control and production excellence features.
- [Breaking Boundaries with Innovation in Aerospace Manufacturing](https://www.deskera.com/industries/aerospace-and-defence): Aerospace manufacturing ERP with inventory, supply chain and real-time analytics.
- [Deliver Quality Products with Manufacturing ERP for Medical Devices](https://www.deskera.com/industries/medical-device-manufacturing): Medical device manufacturing ERP with quality management and traceability features.

## Specialized Manufacturing Verticals

- [Elevating Construction Engineering Framework with Innovative Manufacturing Software Solutions](https://www.deskera.com/industries/construction-and-engineering): Construction and engineering ERP with inventory, procurement, CRM and accounting.
